Decimal is preferable for currency because it represents base-10 values exactly, so amounts like 0.10, 0.01, and 19.99 do not suffer from binary rounding errors. Binary floating point is designed for scientific approximation, so it can produce tiny representation errors that accumulate and lead to incorrect cents in financial calculations.
